title: Fail closed on Tdarr background lifecycle persistence
summary: Make Tdarr Matrix background launch lifecycle evidence durable and fail closed across partial starts.
reason: Remediate P1 AUDIT-FIND-COORD-DIAG-009. A bundled-runtime fault injection confirmed that a post-spawn metadata write failure returns success while close-readiness reports no active work.
behavior_before: The audit child starts before its only lifecycle record is written; an OSError is discarded, success is returned, and close-readiness can report inactive while the child is live.
behavior_after: A verified atomic reservation will exist before spawn, active PID identity will replace it atomically after spawn, and any post-spawn persistence failure will return an actionable failure, attempt exact-child cleanup, and retain fail-closed reconciliation evidence.
tests_added: tests/python/desktop/test_tdarr_background_lifecycle_persistence.py: prelaunch reservation failure, post-spawn identity persistence failure, exact-child cleanup, close-readiness blocking evidence, and reused-PID identity regressions.

Finding disposition before remediation: confirmed. The immutable audit ledger and linked independent attestation remain unchanged. Invariant: a spawned background child must never exist without durable close-readiness evidence. The close-readiness and process-lifecycle no-touch gate requires focused fault injection, active/unavailable close evidence, exact-child cleanup, stale PID identity coverage, and a disposable real child process. Representative real media is not required and is not authorized for this batch. Python impact: yes; backend-owned Tdarr Matrix diagnostics lifecycle only.
